entries.596e6ae718b2a709: In February 1934, the company established Osaka Metal Industry Co., Ltd. and began production of internal combustion engines, precision machinery, aircraft parts and other products. In the same year, it successfully prototyped a methyl chloride refrigerator. In the following year, 1935, it absorbed and merged Osaka Metal Industry Partnership Company. The company regards its establishment date as February 11, 1934.
entries.5a9c000e5a48612b: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥414,991 million (up 3.3% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥408,171 million (up 11.4%), and profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥275,229 million (up 4.0%). Segment profit (operating profit basis) was ¥376,991 million for the Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Business (up 7.4% year on year), ¥33,089 million for the Chemicals Business (down 28.3%) and ¥4,925 million for Other businesses (up 8.4%), and the Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Business generates most of the profit. The company cites an increase in the inflation accounting adjustment (non-operating income) as the factor behind ordinary profit exceeding operating profit.
entries.5af904c1f6dbe111: This is a reportable segment that manufactures (including construction work) and sells air conditioning and refrigeration products. For residential use it handles room air conditioners, air purifiers, heat pump water heaters and heat pump-type hydronic floor heating; for commercial use it handles package air conditioners, multi-split air conditioners for buildings, water chilling units such as turbo chillers and screw chillers, air handling units, refrigerated and freezer showcases, air filters and industrial dust collectors; and for marine use it handles marine container refrigeration units and marine air conditioners. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥4,621,131 million (up 5.4% year on year), accounting for the bulk of consolidated revenue; segment profit (on an operating profit basis) was ¥376,991 million (up 7.4% year on year), and the number of employees was 96,697. The company states that in the same period it worked to expand sales of high value-added products that use the low-GWP refrigerant R32, including the multi-split air conditioner 'VRV 7' and the wall-mounted room air conditioner 'Urusara X'. For data center applied air conditioning, sales grew due to increased production capacity from the start of operations at a new plant of a custom air handling unit maker.

entries.7fa0b72f6fea0a35: The main businesses conducted by the company and its affiliated companies are the manufacture (including construction work) and sale of air-conditioning and refrigeration equipment, chemicals, hydraulic equipment and special products, and DAIKIN INDUSTRIES,LTD. itself manufactures and sells across all of these businesses, while each affiliated company takes on part of them. The reportable segments are two, the Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Business and the Chemicals Business, divided by similarity of products and services, while the Hydraulic Equipment Business, Special Products Business and Electronic Systems Business are grouped under 'Other'. The company defines its mission and responsibility as 'continuing to provide comfort and peace of mind to people around the world,' and upholds 'management with people at its core,' which draws out workers' motivation and sense of conviction, 'flat & speed organizational management' based on discussion, and 'diversity management,' which makes use of each individual's personality. In the medium term, it sets the direction of development every five years in its strategic management plan 'FUSION,' and under 'FUSION30,' formulated in 2026, it aims to become a highly profitable sustainable company that continues to be chosen worldwide while providing 'new value for the environment and air,' and has made 'transformation into a solutions provider' one of its priority themes. Because most products are made to stock, the securities report omits the statement of order volume and order backlog.

entries.81213f2a3708e0c1: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells fluorochemical products. It handles fluorocarbon gases used as refrigerants; fluororesins such as tetrafluoroethylene resins, melt-processable resins, fluororubbers and fluorine paints; and chemical products such as etching agents for semiconductors, water- and oil-repellents, release agents, surfactants, fluorinated oils and pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥281,469 million (up 7.0% year on year), segment profit was ¥33,089 million (down 28.3% year on year), and the number of employees was 4,341. The company explains that the decline in profit was largely due to the heavy impact of slowing semiconductor demand; while distribution inventory adjustments in the semiconductor field continued for an extended period, fluororubber sales grew, mainly for automotive markets in China and in Europe and the United States.
